original: dvitvaṃ janayati | tatra dvitvasya candramasaścāsaṃbandhāgrahādvau candrāvityevaṃ vyavahāraḥ | tathā sarvatodiśamāśutarasaṃcāriṇyalātadaṇḍe'pi nirantaradhiyo jāyante| tatrāntarālāgrahaṇāccakrabuddhivyavahāraḥ | alāte ca cakravyavahāraḥ| tathā darpaṇe nayanaraśmirnipatitaḥ prathamaṃ saviśeṣaṃ darpaṇaṃ gṛhṇāti|
analyzed: dvi tvam janayati tatra dvi tvasya candramasaḥ ca asaṃbandha agrahāt dvau candrau iti evam vyavahāraḥ tathā sarvatodiśam āśutara saṃcāriṇi alāta daṇḍe pi nirantara dhiyaḥ jāyante tatra antarāla agrahaṇāt cakra buddhi vyavahāraḥ alāte ca cakra vyavahāraḥ tathā darpaṇe nayana raśmiḥ nipatitaḥ prathamam sa viśeṣam darpaṇam gṛhṇāti

original: paścāttu pratihataḥ parāvṛtto mukhamātram | tatra darpaṇasya mukhasya ca bhedāgrahāddarpaṇe mukhavyavahāraḥ| tadgatānāṃ savyadakṣiṇamahattvālpatvādidharmāṇāṃ mukhasya ca bhedāgrahāt | mukhe taddeśādivyavahāraśca ||
analyzed: paścāt tu pratihataḥ parāvṛttaḥ mukha mātram tatra darpaṇasya mukhasya ca bheda agrahāt darpaṇe mukha vyavahāraḥ tad gatānām savya dakṣiṇa mahat tva alpa tva ādi dharmāṇām mukhasya ca bheda agrahāt mukhe tad deśa ādi vyavahāraḥ ca

original: svapnastu smṛtireva | na hyananubhūte sa samudeti | doṣācca tattāpramoṣaḥ| grahaṇākāraśca adṛṣṭavaśādarthānāmanubhūtatvaṃ ca nādhyavasīyate | avasthāviśeṣo'dṛṣṭaṃ ca saṃskārodbodhakam | ata eva jāgratastādṛgeva dhīḥ ||
analyzed: svapnaḥ tu smṛtiḥ eva na hi ananubhūte sa samudeti doṣāt ca tattā pramoṣaḥ grahaṇa ākāraḥ ca adṛṣṭa vaśāt arthānām anubhūta tvam ca na adhyavasīyate avasthā viśeṣa udṛṣṭam ca saṃskāra udbodhakam atas eva jāgrataḥ tādṛś eva dhīḥ

original: tathā saṃśayo'pi naikaṃ vijñānam | kintu dve ete sthāṇutvapuruṣatvagocare pramṛṣṭatattāṃśe parasparavinirmukte puraḥ sthitordhvavastudarśanājjāyamāne smṛtirupe | etatsarvaṃ yathārthameva |
analyzed: tathā saṃśayaḥ api na ekam vijñānam kintu dve ete sthāṇu tva puruṣa tva gocare pramṛṣṭa tatta aṃśe paraspara vinirmukte puras sthita ūrdhva vastu darśanāt jāyamāne smṛti rupe etat sarvam yathārtham eva

original: parasparavinirmuktayostayorviśeṣayoḥ puraḥsthite dharmiṇi ekasyāpi vyavasthā nāstīti vyavasthitavyavahāraṃ pravartayitā pravartayitumaśaknuvan saṃśeta iti bhavati tatra saṃśayavyavahāraḥ| kiṃ ca kasyacidbhānasyārthavyabhicāre sarvasyāpi tathātvaśaṅ‌kāyāṃ jagati viśvāso na syāt||
analyzed: paraspara vinirmuktayoḥ tayoḥ viśeṣayoḥ puras sthite dharmiṇi ekasya api vyavasthā na asti iti vyavasthita vyavahāram pravartayitā pravartayitum aśaknuvan saṃśete iti bhavati tatra saṃśaya vyavahāraḥ kim ca kasyacid bhānasya artha vyabhicāre sarvasya api tathātva śaṅkāyām jagati viśvāsaḥ na syāt

original: nanu tvanmate'pi kutracidbhāne bhedāgrahanibandhanapraghṛttau vyavahāravisaṃvāde sarvatra tathātvaśaṅ‌kāyāmaviśvāsastadavastha eveti cet na, vaiṣamyāt | yāthārthye hi sādhāraṇe ' yadbhānaṃ tatsatyam ' iti sarvatra svārasiko viśvāsaḥ | pravṛttiśca svārasikī | kkacidaviśvāse sopyalpāyāsena nivartate |
analyzed: nanu tvad mate api kutracid bhāne bheda agraha nibandhana praghṛttau vyavahāra visaṃvāde sarvatra tathātva śaṅkāyām aviśvāsaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva iti ced na vaiṣamyāt yāthārthye hi sādhāraṇe yat bhānam tat satyam iti sarvatra svārasikaḥ viśvāsaḥ pravṛttiḥ ca svārasikī kkacid aviśvāse saḥ api alpa āyāsena nivartate

original: pravṛttyuttarakālaṃ vyavahārāvisaṃvāde pūrvajñānasya viśiṣṭārthagocaratvaniścayāt| visaṃvāde tu kevalaṃ parasparavinirmuktā gṛhītabhedatattadvastugocaratvaniścayāt ||
analyzed: pravṛtti uttara kālam vyavahāra avisaṃvāde pūrva jñānasya viśiṣṭa artha gocara tva niścayāt visaṃvāde tu kevalam paraspara vinirmuktāḥ gṛhīta bheda tad tad vastu gocara tva niścayāt

original: atassarvaṃ jñānaṃ yathārtham | yāthārthye'pi smṛtirapramāṇam | anubhūtiḥ
analyzed: atas sarvam jñānam yathārtham yāthārthye pi smṛtiḥ apramāṇam anubhūtiḥ

original: pramāṇamiti siddham ||
analyzed: pramāṇam iti siddham

original: ācāryaistu - 'dṛḍhamavisaṃvādi agṛhītagrāhi vijñānaṃ pramāṇam ' iti pramāṇasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ nibaddham | tacca prāmāṇyaṃ svataḥ, aprāmāṇyaṃ parata ityapi nibaddham | datuktam -
analyzed: ācāryaiḥ tu dṛḍham avisaṃvādi agṛhīta grāhi vijñānam pramāṇam iti pramāṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇam nibaddham tat ca prāmāṇyam svatas aprāmāṇyam paratas iti api nibaddham dat uktam

original: tasmāddṛḍhaṃ yadutpannaṃ na visaṃvādamṛcchati |
analyzed: tasmāt dṛḍham yat utpannam na visaṃvādam ṛcchati

original: jñānāntareṇa vijñānaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ pratīyatām ||
analyzed: jñāna antareṇa vijñānam tat pramāṇam pratīyatām

original: iti | tacchiṣyaiśca tatsvatastvaṃ bahudhā prapañcitam| tathāhi - tatra keciditthaṃ vyācakhyuḥ - svaśabdo'yamātmīyavacanaḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ cārthatathātvam| jāyata iti ca yogyatayā'dhyāhriyate | tataścāyamarthaḥ - svīyādeva kāraṇādarthatathātvalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ jāyate, na guṇāt, tasya doṣapratibandhamātra evopakṣīṇatvāt|
analyzed: iti tad śiṣyaiḥ ca tat svatastvam bahudhā prapañcitam tathā hi tatra kecid ittham vyācakhyuḥ sva śabdaḥ iyam ātmīya vacanaḥ prāmāṇyam ca artha tathātvam jāyate iti ca yogyatayā adhyāhriyate tatas ca ayam arthaḥ svīyāt eva kāraṇāt artha tathātva lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam jāyate na guṇāt tasya doṣa pratibandha mātre eva upakṣīṇa tvāt

original: guṇādhīne tu prāmāṇye vedasyāpauruṣeyatayā vaktṛguṇābhāvena prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt| etadvilakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyaṃ na svīyātkāraṇājjāyate, kintu doṣādityaprāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ| ata evedaṃ rajatamityādiṣu svīyātkāraṇādidamaṃśasya svatastvam | doṣāttu rajatāṃśasya mithyātvamiti ||
analyzed: guṇa adhīne tu prāmāṇye vedasya apauruṣeya tayā vaktṛ guṇa abhāvena prāmāṇyam na syāt etat vilakṣaṇam aprāmāṇyam na svīyāt kāraṇāt jāyate kintu doṣāt iti aprāmāṇyam paratas atas eva idam rajatam ityādiṣu svīyāt kāraṇāt idam aṃśasya svatastvam doṣāt tu rajata aṃśasya mithyātvam iti

original: etanmatamācāryagranthānuguṇaṃ na bhavatīti tadīyairevopekṣitam ||
analyzed: etat matam ācārya grantha anuguṇam na bhavati iti tadīyaiḥ eva upekṣitam

original: anye tu - svaśabdo'yamātmavacanaḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ cānadhigatatathābhūtārthaniścayaḥ| tataśca svatojñānasvarupāttādṛśaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ jāyate| na tu guṇajñānādarthakriyājñānādvā| aprāmaṇyaṃ tu parato doṣajñānādarthānyathātvajñānādveti | ayamapi pakṣastadīyaireva pratikṣiptaḥ | tatra tāvadaprāmāṇyasya parato janma yuktam |
analyzed: anye tu sva śabdaḥ yam ātma vacanaḥ prāmāṇyam ca anadhigata tathābhūta artha niścayaḥ tatas ca svatas jñāna svarupāt tādṛśam prāmāṇyam jāyate na tu guṇa jñānāt artha kriyā jñānāt vā aprāmaṇyam tu paratas doṣa jñānāt artha anyathātva jñānāt vā iti ayam api pakṣaḥ tadīyaiḥ eva pratikṣiptaḥ tatra tāvat aprāmāṇyasya paratas janma yuktam

original: na hi rajatajñānasyāprāmāṇyaṃ doṣajñānādijanyaṃ, utpattāvevāpramāṇatvāt | atathābhūtārthaniścayo'prāmāṇyam| taccāpramāṇajñāne svata eva bhavati, na bādhakajñānādikamapekṣate | na hyutpattau pramāṇaṃ satpaścādbādhakenāpramāṇīkriyate| api tūtpattāveva jñātamaprāmāṇyaṃ paścādbādhakena jñāpyate | kiṃ ca prāmāṇyasyāpi svato janma ayuktam |
analyzed: na hi rajata jñānasya aprāmāṇyam doṣa jñāna ādi janyam utpattau eva apramāṇa tvāt atathābhūta artha niścaya uprāmāṇyam tat ca apramāṇa jñāne svatas eva bhavati na bādhaka jñāna ādikam apekṣate na hi utpattau pramāṇam sat paścāt bādhakena apramāṇīkriyate api tu utpattau eva jñātam aprāmāṇyam paścāt bādhakena jñāpyate kim ca prāmāṇyasya api svatas janma ayuktam

original: svata iti jñānasvarupamatraṃ cedvivakṣitaṃ tadā mithyājñānasyāpi svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt, tatrāpi
analyzed: svatas iti jñāna svarupa matram ced vivakṣitam tadā mithyājñānasya api svatas prāmāṇyam syāt tatra api

original: jñānasvarupasyāviśeṣāt | atha samyagjñānaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, tadā pramāṇajñānātprāmāṇyotpattiruktā syāt | tadā svasmātsvasyotpattissyāt, samyagjñānasvarupāvyatirekātprāmāṇyasya ||
analyzed: jñāna svarupasya aviśeṣāt atha samyak jñānam vivakṣitam tadā pramāṇa jñānāt prāmāṇya utpattiḥ uktā syāt tadā svasmāt svasya utpattiḥ syāt samyak jñāna svarupa avyatirekāt prāmāṇyasya

original: apare tu - svaśabdo jñānaparaḥ| yogyatayā ca bhātītyadhyāhriyate | jñānāttadgataṃ prāmāṇyaṃ jñāpyate | aprāmāṇyaṃ tu parato gamyata iti | tadapi tadīyaireva nirastam | na hi jñānamātmānamātmīyaṃ vā prāmāmyaṃ gṛhṇāti, tasyārthagrahaṇamātropakṣīṇatvāt| na hyutpannaṃ jñānamahaṃ pramāṇaṃ madīyaṃ vā prāmāṇyamiti pratibhāti |
analyzed: apare tu sva śabdaḥ jñāna paraḥ yogyatayā ca bhāti iti adhyāhriyate jñānāt tad gatam prāmāṇyam jñāpyate aprāmāṇyam tu paratas gamyate iti tat api tadīyaiḥ eva nirastam na hi jñānam ātmānam ātmīyam vā prāmāmyam gṛhṇāti tasya artha grahaṇa mātra upakṣīṇa tvāt na hi utpannam jñānam aham pramāṇam madīyam vā prāmāṇyam iti pratibhāti

original: jñānaṃ tu kevalamarthaprakāśānyathānupapattyā kalpyate | prāmāṇyamapi tata eva | tasmātsvato bhātītyanupapannamiti ||
analyzed: jñānam tu kevalam artha prakāśa anyathā anupapattyā kalpyate prāmāṇyam api tatas eva tasmāt svatas bhāti iti anupapannam iti

original: ācāryamatatatvavedinastu - svaśabdo'yamātmavacanaḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ cārthavattvam| bhātīti cādhyāhāraḥ | jñānasvarupādevārthatathātvalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ bhātīti jñānamātrasyārthatathātvaprakāśakatvaṃ svārasikamiti yāvaditi | taduktaṃ tadīyaiḥ -
analyzed: ācārya mata tatva vedinaḥ tu sva śabdaḥ yam ātma vacanaḥ prāmāṇyam ca arthavattvam bhāti iti ca adhyāhāraḥ jñāna svarupāt eva artha tathātva lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam bhāti iti jñāna mātrasya artha tathātva prakāśaka tvam svārasikam iti yāvat iti tat uktam tadīyaiḥ

original: ātmavācī svaśabdo'yaṃ svato bhāti pramāṇatā |
analyzed: ātma vācī sva śabdaḥ iyam svatas bhāti pramāṇa tā

original: arthasya ca tathābhāvaḥ prāmāṇyamiti gīyate||
analyzed: arthasya ca tathā bhāvaḥ prāmāṇyam iti gīyate

original: yadarthatathātvaṃ yadvaśācca jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tadbhānaṃ svarupādeva bhāti, na tu guṇajñānādarthakriyājñānātsaṃvādajñānādvetyautsargikaṃ prāmāṇyam| arthānyathātvalakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyaṃ na svato bhāti| kintu kāraṇadoṣajñānānnedamiti vādhakajñānādveti parata ityupapāditamaprāmāṇyamiti| yathāhurācāryāḥ -
analyzed: yad artha tathātvam yad vaśāt ca jñānam pramāṇam tad bhānam sva rupāt eva bhāti na tu guṇa jñānāt artha kriyā jñānāt saṃvāda jñānāt vā iti autsargikam prāmāṇyam artha anyathātva lakṣaṇam aprāmāṇyam na svatas bhāti kintu kāraṇa doṣa jñānāt na idam iti vādhaka jñānāt vā iti paratas iti upapāditam aprāmāṇyam iti yathā āhuḥ ācāryāḥ

original: tasmātsvataḥ pramāṇatvaṃ sarvatrautsargikaṃ sthitam|
analyzed: tasmāt svatas pramāṇa tvam sarvatra autsargikam sthitam

original: bhādhakāraṇaduṣṭatvajñānābhyāṃ tadapodyate ||
analyzed: bhādha kāraṇa duṣṭa tva jñānābhyām tat apodyate

original: iti | sthitaṃ prāptaṃ pratipannamiti yāvat | sarvatreti na kevalaṃ pramāṇeṣu kintu jñānamātra ityarthaḥ | na hi pramāṇajñānānyadhikṛtyeyaṃ cintā, yata autsargikatvaṃ na syāt | kiṃ nāma saṃśayasmṛtivilakṣaṇāni ? tayoraprāmāṇyasya spaṣṭatvāt na tau
analyzed: iti sthitam prāptam pratipannam iti yāvat sarvatra iti na kevalam pramāṇeṣu kintu jñāna mātre iti arthaḥ na hi pramāṇa jñānāni adhikṛtya iyam cintā yata autsargika tvam na syāt kim nāma saṃśaya smṛti vilakṣaṇāni tayoḥ aprāmāṇyasya spaṣṭa tvāt na tau

original: vicāragocarau | yadi pramāṇajñānānyadhikṛtyeyaṃ cintā syāt tadā teṣāmeva svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ sādhitaṃ syāt | tathā ca vedasyobhayavādisiddhaprāmāṇyābhāvena vicārāviṣayatvānna tatsādhitaṃ syāt | tathā ca tatprāmāṇyānupayoginī cintā kākadantaparīkṣāvadakartavyā syāt |
analyzed: vicāra gocarau yadi pramāṇa jñānāni adhikṛtya iyam cintā syāt tadā teṣām eva svatas prāmāṇyam sādhitam syāt tathā ca vedasya ubhaya vādi siddha prāmāṇya abhāvena vicāra aviṣaya tvāt na tat sādhitam syāt tathā ca tad prāmāṇya anupayoginī cintā kākadanta parīkṣā vat akartavyā syāt

original: jñānamātrādhikāreṇa tu svataḥ prāmāṇye sādhite vedasyāpi sāmānyataḥ prāptaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ kāraṇadoṣāderabhāvānnirapavādamiti saprayojanā syāditi prāmāṇyamautsargikam, anyadāpavādikam ||
analyzed: jñāna mātra adhikāreṇa tu svatas prāmāṇye sādhite vedasya api sāmānyatas prāptam prāmāṇyam kāraṇa doṣa ādeḥ abhāvāt nirapavādam iti sa prayojanā syāt iti prāmāṇyam autsargikam anyat āpavādikam

original: nanvarthatathātvaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ cetsmṛterapi tatprasaṅgaḥ | tayā'pi tathātvaniścayāt| maivam| adhigatatayā'nanusandhānam, arthasya ca tathātvam, jñānasya ca tatra niścayajanaktavamiti tritayamapi prāmāṇyamabhimataṃ loke | tatraiva pramāṇaśabdapravṛtteḥ| ato na smṛteḥ prāmāmyam |
analyzed: nanu artha tathātvam prāmāṇyam ced smṛteḥ api tad prasaṅgaḥ tayā api tathātva niścayāt mā evam adhigata tayā ananusandhānam arthasya ca tathātvam jñānasya ca tatra niścaya janaktavam iti tritayam api prāmāṇyam abhimatam loke tatra eva pramāṇa śabda pravṛtteḥ atas na smṛteḥ prāmāmyam

original: tadayamatra pūrvottarapakṣasaṅkṣepaḥ - ghaṭapadācca ghaṭajñānodayadarśanāt ghaṭasadasadbhāvamātrasādhāraṇena jñānamātreṇa ghaṭo durniścayaḥ | ato na tasya svataḥ prāmāṇyaniścayaḥ | kintvarthakriyājñānātsaṃvādād‌guṇavatkāraṇajñānādvā tanniścayaḥ| kriyājñānamavyabhicārātsvata eva pramāṇam | saṃvādo'pyarthatathātvādeva ghaṭate| tathā guṇo'pi |
analyzed: tat ayam atra pūrva uttara pakṣa saṅkṣepaḥ ghaṭa padāt ca ghaṭa jñāna udaya darśanāt ghaṭa sat asat bhāva mātra sādhāraṇena jñāna mātreṇa ghaṭaḥ durniścayaḥ atas na tasya svatas prāmāṇya niścayaḥ kintu artha kriyā jñānāt saṃvādāt guṇavat kāraṇa jñānāt vā tad niścayaḥ kriyā jñānam avyabhicārāt svatas eva pramāṇam saṃvādaḥ api artha tathātvāt eva ghaṭate tathā guṇaḥ pi artha tathātvāt eva ghaṭate tathā guṇaḥ api

original: tasmātparata eva prāmāṇyaniścayaḥ na svata iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ ||
analyzed: tasmāt paratas eva prāmāṇya niścayaḥ na svatas iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ

original: siddhāntastu - na jñānamavyabhicārāniścayamukhenārthaṃ niścinoti| kintu svata eva | yadi svato niścetuṃ na śaknuyāt taṃdā niścayasyātyantāsambhava ityāndhyamevāśeṣasya jagato bhavet | na hi svato'niścitorthaḥ parato'pi niścetuṃ śakyate, parasyāpi pūrvavadevāsāmarthyāt |

original: sadṛśadarśanāttatsadṛśavastvantaragatasādṛśyajñānamupamānam | yathā pūrvadṛṣṭagoḥ puruṣasya vane gavayaṃ tatsadṛśaṃ paśyato yadgogatagavayapratiyogikasādṛśyajñānaṃ anena sadṛśī madīyā gauriti tadupamānam | nedaṃ pratyakṣaṃ, cakṣussannikarṣātivartinyāṃ gavi jāyamāna tvāt | na smṛtiḥ, pūrvametādṛśānanubhavāt, tatpūrvakatvātsmṛteḥ |
analyzed: sadṛśa darśanāt tad sadṛśa vastu antara gata sādṛśya jñānam upamānam yathā pūrva dṛṣṭa goḥ puruṣasya vane gavayam tad sadṛśam paśyataḥ yat go gata gavaya pratiyogika sādṛśya jñānam anena sadṛśī madīyā gauḥ iti tat upamānam na idam pratyakṣam cakṣuḥ sannikarṣa ativartinyām gavi tvāt na smṛtiḥ pūrvam etādṛśa ananubhavāt tad pūrvaka tvāt smṛteḥ

original: gomātrajñānaṃ tu smṛtireva | nāpyanumānam, vyāptitatpratisandhānapūrvakatvābhāvāt| sadṛśadarśanādityanenaindriyakasādṛśyajñānasyopamānatvanirāsaḥ | avaśiṣṭena ca sādṛśyadarśanānubandhinaḥ bhūyovayavasāmānyajñānādeḥ sādṛśyasya ca pṛthaktatvāntaratvaṃ prameyanirupaṇāvasare bhavipyati ||
analyzed: go mātra jñānam tu smṛtiḥ eva nā api anumānam vyāpti tad pratisandhāna pūrvakatva abhāvāt sadṛśa darśanāt iti anena aindriyaka sādṛśya jñānasya upamāna tva nirāsaḥ avaśiṣṭena ca sādṛśya darśana anubandhinaḥ bhūyas vayava sāmānya jñāna ādeḥ sādṛśyasya ca pṛthaktatva antara tvam prameya nirupaṇa avasare bhavipyati

original: || athārthāpattiḥ ||
analyzed: atha arthāpattiḥ

original: arthāntarakalpanāyāmasatyāṃ yo'rthāntaramanupapannaṃ kurute tatrārthāpattiḥ pravartate| yathā ' jīvan devadatto gṛhe nāsti ' ityatra gṛhābhāve dṛṣṭe śrute vātatrāsati vahirbhāvakalpane gṛhābhāvo jīvanamanupapannaṃ kurvan bahirbhāvaṃ kalpayati | anupapattiścātra saṃdehaḥ |
analyzed: artha antara kalpanāyām asatyām yaḥ ṛtha antaram anupapannam kurute tatra arthāpattiḥ pravartate yathā jīvan devadattaḥ gṛhe na asti iti atra gṛha abhāve dṛṣṭe śrute vā atatra asati vahirbhāva kalpane gṛha abhāvaḥ jīvanam anupapannam kurvan bahirbhāvam kalpayati anupapattiḥ ca atra saṃdehaḥ

original: tathāhi - akalpite vahirbhāve gṛhābhāve ca nirṇīte ' jīvati vā na vā ' iti saṃdeha eva bhavati| kalpite tu tasmin sa praśāmyati| arthasaṃdehāpādako'rthaḥ pramāṇam | vahirbhāvakalpanā pramā | kalpyamāno'rthaḥ prameyam| yadvā pramitiḥ pramāṇamiti vyutpattyā kalpanā pramāṇam | tadanantarabhāvi viśiṣṭajñānaṃ phalamiti ||
analyzed: tathā hi akalpite vahirbhāve gṛha abhāve ca nirṇīte jīvati vā na vā iti saṃdehaḥ eva bhavati kalpite tu tasmin sa praśāmyati artha saṃdeha āpādakaḥ ūrthaḥ pramāṇam vahirbhāva kalpanā pramā kalpyamāna ūrthaḥ prameyam yat vā pramitiḥ pramāṇam iti vyutpattyā kalpanā pramāṇam tad anantara bhāvi viśiṣṭa jñānam phalam iti

original: nanu gṛhābhāvadarśanādbahirbhāvakalpanamanumānameva | tathāhi - devadatto bahirasti gṛhe avidyamānatve sati jīvanavattvāt, yo jīvaṃstatra nāsti sa tato'nyatrāsti, yathāham, iti cet ? maivaṃ - jīvanāṃśe saṃdigdhāsaṃdigdhatvāt |
analyzed: nanu gṛha abhāva darśanāt bahirbhāva kalpanam anumānam eva tathā hi devadattaḥ bahis asti gṛhe avidyamāna tve sati jīvanavat tvāt yaḥ jīvan tatra na asti sa tatas nyatra asti yathā aham iti ced mā evam jīvana aṃśe saṃdigdha asaṃdigdha tvāt

original: nanu jīvanaṃ pramāṇāntarapratipannaṃ kathaṃ saṃdigdham ? satyaṃ pramite hi vastuni pūrvapratipannarūpādrūpāntaraprāptau saṃdeho bhavatyeva | pūrvaṃ hi jīvanaṃ gṛhasaṃbaddhameva pramitam | saṃprati tatsaṃbandhe nivṛtte bahirdeśasaṃbandhe cākalpite jīvane saṃdeho bhavatyeva | ' pūrvaṃ jīvan devadatto gṛha eva dṛṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: nanu jīvanam pramāṇa antara pratipannam katham saṃdigdham satyam pramite hi vastuni pūrva pratipanna rūpāt rūpa antara prāptau saṃdehaḥ bhavati eva pūrvam hi jīvanam gṛha saṃbaddham eva pramitam saṃprati tad saṃbandhe nivṛtte bahis deśa saṃbandhe ca akalpite jīvane saṃdehaḥ bhavati eva pūrvam jīvan devadattaḥ gṛhe eva dṛṣṭaḥ

original: idānīṃ sa gṛhe nāsti jīvati vā na vā ' iti| tarhi bahirdeśasaṃbandhakalpanādasadigdhaṃ jīvanaṃ liṃgamiti cet (evaṃ cet) anumeyābhāvaḥ| bahirdeśasaṃbandha eva anumitsitaḥ| sa tu nirṇotaścedanumeyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate| kevalagṛhābhāvo'pi na liṅgaṃ, mṛtajaniṣyamāṇayorvyabhicārāt | ato'tra nānumānāvakāśaḥ | atasasaṃdehāpādako'rtho'rthāpattiriti sthitam |
analyzed: idānīm sa gṛhe na asti jīvati vā na vā iti tarhi bahis deśa saṃbandha kalpanāt asadigdham jīvanam liṃgam iti ced evam ced anumeya abhāvaḥ bahis deśa saṃbandhaḥ eva anumitsitaḥ sa tu nirṇotaḥ ced anumeyam na avaśiṣyate kevala gṛha abhāvaḥ api na liṅgam mṛta janiṣyamāṇayoḥ vyabhicārāt atas utra na anumāna avakāśaḥ sthitam

original: na hi dhūmādikaṃ kasyacidarthasya saṃśayāpādanadvāreṇa liṅgamiti tato vaiṣamyam| tathā pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅ‌kta ityatrākalpite rātribhojane pīnatā rātribhojane pramāṇam || taduktam -
analyzed: na hi dhūma ādikam kasyacid arthasya saṃśaya āpādana dvāreṇa liṅgam iti tatas vaiṣamyam tathā pīnaḥ devadattaḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti atra akalpite rātri bhojane pīna tā rātri bhojane pramāṇam tat uktam

original: tatsaṃdehavyudāsāya kalpanā yā pravartate |
analyzed: tad saṃdeha vyudāsāya kalpanā yā pravartate

original: saṃdehāpādakādarthādarthāpattirasau smṛtā ||
analyzed: saṃdeha āpādakāt arthāt arthāpattiḥ asau smṛtā

original: iti| anye punarevaṃ menire - yasminnakalpite yo'rthaḥ pratīto'pi pūrvaparidṛṣṭasvarūpaparivṛttyā saṃśayarupāmanupapattiṃ bhajate so'rthaḥ svagatasaṃdehavyudāsāya arthāntarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam | yathā pūrvoktaṃ jīvanasāmānyaṃ bhojanamātraṃ ca| dhūmādyanumānaṃ naitādṛśaṃ, ekatrāniścitakaraṇamaparatra saṃdigdhamiti tato vaiṣamyam || taduktam -
analyzed: iti anye punar evam menire yasmin akalpite yaḥ ṛthaḥ pratītaḥ api pūrva paridṛṣṭa sva rūpa parivṛttyā saṃśaya rupām anupapattim bhajate saḥ ṛthaḥ svagata saṃdeha vyudāsāya artha antara kalpanāyām pramāṇam yathā pūrva uktam jīvana sāmānyam bhojana mātram ca dhūma ādi anumānam na etādṛśam ekatra aniścita karaṇam aparatra saṃdigdham iti tatas vaiṣamyam tat uktam

original: yatkalpanāṃ vinā yo'rthaḥ pratīto'pyeti saṃśayam |
analyzed: yad kalpanām vinā yaḥ ṛthaḥ pratītā upyeti saṃśayam

original: tena tatkalpanāmeke tvarthāpattiṃ pracakṣate ||
analyzed: tena tad kalpanām eke tu arthāpattim pracakṣate

original: iti || kecittu gṛhābhāva evānyathā'nupapadyamānassanvahirbhāvakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇamityāhuḥ | tadayuktam | tatra gṛhābhāvasya kā'nupapattiḥ ? asati bahissattve svasyābhāva iti cet, tarhi sādhyābhāve hetvabhāvaripovyatireka eva |
analyzed: iti kecid tu gṛha abhāvaḥ eva anyathā anupapadyamānaḥ san vahirbhāva kalpanāyām pramāṇam iti āhuḥ tat ayuktam tatra gṛha abhāvasya kā anupapattiḥ asati bahis sattve svasya abhāvaḥ iti ced tarhi sādhya abhāve hetu abhāva ripo vyatirekaḥ eva

original: sa ca hetusadbhāve sādhyasadbhāvalakṣaṇenānvayenāvagamyata ityanvayavyatirekamukhena pravartamānatvādidamanumānameveti nārthāpatteḥ pṛthakprāmāṇyasaṃbhavaḥ | atassaṃdehāpādako'rthastenāpāditasaṃdeho'rtho vā'rthāpattiriti sthitam ||
analyzed: sa ca hetu sadbhāve sādhya sadbhāva lakṣaṇena anvayena avagamyate iti anvaya vyatireka mukhena pravartamāna tvāt idam anumānam eva iti na arthāpatteḥ pṛthak prāmāṇya saṃbhavaḥ atas saṃdeha āpādaka ūrthaḥ tena āpādita saṃdeha ūrthaḥ vā arthāpattiḥ iti sthitam

original: atra kecit - yatrārthānupapattiḥ pramāṇāntarapratipannā tatrārthāntarameva kalpyamiti sā dṛṣṭārthāpattiḥ | yatra tu vākyapratipannā ' pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅ‌kte 'iti tatra ' rātrau bhuṅ‌kte ' iti vākyameva kalpyam | ' śābdī hyākāṅkṣā śabdenaiva paripūryate ' iti nyāyāt | atassā śrutārthāpattiriti arthāpattidvaividhyamāhuḥ| tadayuktam|
analyzed: atra kecid yatra artha anupapattiḥ pramāṇa antara pratipannā tatra artha antaram eva kalpyam iti sā dṛṣṭa artha āpattiḥ yatra tu vākya pratipannā pīnaḥ devadattaḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti tatra rātrau bhuṅkte iti vākyam eva kalpyam śābdī hi ākāṅkṣā śabdena eva paripūryate iti nyāyāt atas sā śrutā arthāpattiḥ iti arthāpatti dvaividhyam āhuḥ tat ayuktam

original: atrāpyarthasyaiva kalpayitumucitatvāt | yasminnakalpite'nupapattiḥ kalpite tu tacchāntiḥ ataḥ tadeva kalpyaṃ anyathā hyavyutpannapadavākyaprayoge tu tacchāntiriti tadeva kalpyamiti| tarhi padārthajñānādeva tacchāntiriti arthaparikalpanamevocatam| ubhayaparikalpane gauravaṃ ca |
analyzed: atra api arthasya eva kalpayitum ucita tvāt yasmin kalpite anupapattiḥ kalpite tu tad śāntiḥ atas tat eva kalpyam anyathā hi avyutpanna pada vākya prayoge tu tad śāntiḥ iti tat eva kalpyam iti tarhi padārtha jñānāt eva tad śāntiḥ iti artha parikalpanam ubhaya parikalpane gauravam ca

original: dṛṣṭārthāpattāvarthasyaiva kalpyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti tadevātrāpi kalpyatām | śābdī hyākāṅkṣā kalpitārthānvayenāpi śāmyati, tasyaivākāṃṅkṣitatvāt | ata eva ' dvāram ' ityādau adhyāhārasthale buddhistenaiva
analyzed: dṛṣṭārtha āpattau arthasya eva kalpya tvam dṛṣṭam iti tat eva atra api kalpyatām śābdī hi ākāṅkṣā kalpita artha anvayena api śāmyati tasya eva ākāṃṅkṣita tvāt atas eva dvāram ityādau adhyāhāra sthale buddhiḥ tena eva

original: saṃvaraṇādinā'nvitāmidhānaṃ na tu ' saṃvriyatām ' ityadhyāhṛtena, śabdena buddhisannihitenāpyanvitāmidhānopapatteḥ| jijñāsāvaśena kkacitparaṃ prati śabdaprayogasaṃbhavaḥ, na tu niyamena ||
analyzed: saṃvaraṇa ādinā anvita amidhānam na tu saṃvriyatām iti adhyāhṛtena śabdena buddhi sannihitena api anvita amidhāna upapatteḥ jijñāsā vaśena kkacid param prati śabda prayoga saṃbhavaḥ na tu niyamena

original: nanvarthakalpanāya pravṛttārthāpattiḥ tasyārthasya savikalpakajñānaviṣayatvāt| teṣāṃ ca śabdapurassaratvāttadvācakaśabdaparyantaṃ vyāpriyata iti cenna | sarvatra savikalpakapratyakṣe svārthānumāne ca tadabhāvāt | na hi te śabdaparyantaṃ vyāpriyete, vadhiramūkatiraścāṃ tadasaṃbhāvāt | kiṃtvarthamātre |
analyzed: nanu artha kalpanāya pravṛttā arthāpattiḥ tasya arthasya savikalpaka jñāna viṣaya tvāt teṣām ca śabda purassara tvāt tad vācaka śabda paryantam vyāpriyate iti ced na sarvatra savikalpaka pratyakṣe svārtha anumāne ca tad abhāvāt na hi te śabda paryantam vyāpriyete vadhira mūka tiraścām tad asaṃbhāvāt kiṃtu artha mātre

original: kiṃ ca sarvatra savikalpakajñāneṣu hi sa śabdaśravaṇaviparivarto, na tu prameyam| arthadarśanāddhi vācakaśabdassmaryata iti vicārāsahametat | śabdaṃ tu pramāṇaṃ svāvasare nirupayiṣyāmaḥ | tasmādarthāpattyā saha pañca pramāṇāni | etatsarvaṃ pramāṇapārāyaṇe prapañcitam | vedārthavicārānupayogānnāsmākaṃ tatrātinirbandhaḥ ||
analyzed: kim ca sarvatra savikalpaka jñāneṣu hi sa śabda śravaṇa viparivartaḥ na tu prameyam artha darśanāt hi vācaka śabdaḥ smaryate iti vicāra asaham etat śabdam tu pramāṇam sva avasare nirupayiṣyāmaḥ tasmāt arthāpattyā saha pañca pramāṇāni etat sarvam pramāṇa pārāyaṇe prapañcitam veda artha vicāra anupayogāt na asmākam tatra ati nirbandhaḥ

original: || abhāvapramāṇanirāsaḥ ||

abhāvākhyaṃ ṣaṣṭhe pramāṇamabhāvagrahaṇāya kaiścidaṅ‌gīkriyate | abhāvasya bhāvavilakṣaṇatayā bhāvarupapramāṇena tadgrahaṇāśakteḥ pañcapramāṇānutpattirupamabhāvarupaṃ pramāṇameṣitavyamiti | tadayuktaṃ, prameyābhāvāt | nanu kathaṃ tadabhāvaḥ ? ' iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti ' iti tāvadasti pratītiḥ |
analyzed: abhāva ākhyam ṣaṣṭhe pramāṇam abhāva grahaṇāya kaiścid aṅgīkriyate abhāvasya bhāva vilakṣaṇa tayā bhāva rupa pramāṇena tad grahaṇa aśakteḥ pañca pramāṇa anutpatti rupam abhāva rupam pramāṇam eṣitavyam iti tat ayuktam prameya abhāvāt nanu katham tad abhāvaḥ iha bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti tāvat asti pratītiḥ

original: sā kiṃ bhūtalasvarūpaviṣayā, atha kevalaṃ tadviṣayā ? nādyaḥ, ghaṭavatyapi prasaṅ‌gāt | na dvitīyaḥ, pūrvoktadoṣānativṛtteḥ| dvitīye tvabhāvāṅ‌gīkāraḥ | kiṃ ca kaṇṭakādivirahiṇi bhūtalādau niśśaṅ‌kaḥ padanyāsādivyavahārastāvatkiṃ bhūtalamātraparicchedanibandhanaḥ ? atha kevalabhūtalaparicchedaḥ |
analyzed: sā kim bhū tala svarūpa viṣayā atha kevalam tad viṣayā na ādyaḥ ghaṭavati api prasaṅgāt na dvitīyaḥ pūrva ukta doṣa anativṛtteḥ dvitīye tu abhāva aṅgīkāraḥ kim ca kaṇṭaka ādi virahiṇi bhū tala ādau niśśaṅkaḥ padanyāsa ādi vyavahāraḥ tāvat kim bhū tala mātra pariccheda nibandhanaḥ atha kevala bhū tala paricchedaḥ

original: tathā ca sūkṣmakaṇṭakādiṣvanavagateṣvapi niśśaṅ‌kavyavahāraḥ syāt | prayatnapūrvikā tajjijñāsā ca nih‌nutā syāt | dvitīye tvabhāvākhyaṃ prameyamaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt | tadānīṃ hi tatparicchedanibandhano vyavahāro yuktaḥ| pratiyogiparāmarśarthaṃ jijñāsā ca| kiṃ cābhāvānaṅgīkāre nāstiśabdo nirarthakaḥ syāt|
analyzed: tathā ca sūkṣma kaṇṭaka ādiṣu anavagateṣu api niśśaṅka vyavahāraḥ syāt prayatna pūrvikā tad jijñāsā ca nihnutā syāt dvitīye tu abhāva ākhyam prameyam aṅgīkṛtam syāt tadānīm hi tad pariccheda nibandhanaḥ vyavahāraḥ yuktaḥ pratiyogi parāmarśa artham jijñāsā ca kim ca abhāva anaṅgīkāre nāstiśabdaḥ nirarthakaḥ syāt

original: śaśādīnāṃ śṛṅgānumānaṃ syāt | idaṃ rajatamityasya bādhaśca na syāt | tadaṅ‌gīkāre tu sārthakaḥ | vādhitaviṣayatvaṃ cānumānasya yuktam | bādhaśca yuktaḥ | tasmādasti bhāvavilakṣaṇaṃ tatvāntaramiti ||
analyzed: śaśa ādīnām śṛṅga anumānam syāt idam rajatam iti asya bādhaḥ ca na syāt tad aṅgīkāre tu sārthakaḥ vādhita viṣaya tvam ca anumānasya yuktam bādhaḥ ca yuktaḥ tasmāt asti bhāva vilakṣaṇam tattva antaram iti

original: idamidānīṃ vicārayāmaḥ - kiṃ tadbhāvapramāṇabodhyaṃ, utābhāvabodhyamiti ? tatra na tāvatpratyakṣabodhyaṃ indriyavyāpāroparame'pyavagateḥ | kathamayaṃ nirṇayaḥ ? abhāvastāvatkutracitkasyacitpratyetavyaḥ iha tanneti | tataśca yatra pratyetavyaḥ tad‌grahaṇa evendriyamuparamate | nābhāvagrahaṇe, tena saha saṃbandhābhāvāt |
analyzed: idam idānīm vicārayāmaḥ kim tat bhāva pramāṇa bodhyam uta abhāva bodhyam iti tatra na tāvat pratyakṣa bodhyam indriya vyāpāra uparame pi avagateḥ katham ayam nirṇayaḥ abhāvaḥ tāvat kutracid kasyacid pratyetavyaḥ iha tat na iti tatas ca yatra pratyetavyaḥ tad grahaṇe eva indriyam uparamate na abhāva grahaṇe tena saha saṃbandha abhāvāt

original: tasmādabhāvapramāṇagocarobhāvaḥ | kathamayaṃ vibhāgo'vasitaḥ ? ucyate - gṛhādisvarupamanubhūya deśāntaragataḥ puruṣaḥ vastvantarābhāvapraśne sati bhāvāntaraṃ jijñāsamānasya praṣṭustathaiva nāstītyuttaraṃ pratipadyate || taduktam -
analyzed: tasmāt abhāva pramāṇa gocaraḥ bhāvaḥ katham ayam vibhāga uvasitaḥ ucyate gṛha ādi svarupam anubhūya deśa antara gataḥ puruṣaḥ vastu antara abhāva praśne sati bhāva antaram jijñāsamānasya praṣṭuḥ tathā eva na asti iti uttaram pratipadyate tat uktam

original: svarūpamātraṃ draṣṭā ca paścātkiṃcitsamarannapi |
analyzed: sva rūpa mātram draṣṭā ca paścāt kiṃcid samaran api

original: tatrāsya nāstitāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ tathaiva pratipadyate ||
analyzed: tatra asya nāstitām pṛṣṭaḥ tathā eva pratipadyate

original: bhāva eva tvekākī sadvitīyaśceti dvayīmavasthāṃ labhate| tatraikākī bhāvodaya eva vināśaśabdavācyaḥ| tvanmate'pi tāddaśyavasthā'vaśyāṅ‌gīkāryetyadhastāduktam | evaṃ niranvayavināśiṣvapi buddhiprabhṛtiṣu dharmiṇaḥ svarūpāvasthānameva bhāvāntarodayo'vagantavyaḥ |

original: tacca śabdanityatve syāt iti tannityatvapasādhanaṃ vyutpattparthatayāpi saprayojanaṃ syāt |

analyzed: na etat sāram syātām nāma krameṇa kārya vargasya sṛṣṭi vināśau pramāṇam na paśyāmaḥ vaiparītye tu vimataḥ kālaḥ na kṛtsna kārya dhvaṃsavān kāla tvāt saṃprati panna kāla vat iti yat vā vimataḥ ghaṭa dhvaṃsaḥ sarvadā ghaṭa antara samāna kālīnaḥ dhvaṃsa tvāt

original: kiṃca kṛtsnakāryadhvaṃse sarvātmagatādṛṣṭadhvaṃsāt punassṛṣṭivaiṣamyaṃ na syāt | " idaṃ vā agre naiva kiṃcanāsīt, na dyaurāsīt na pṛthivī nāntarikṣam " tathā ' sadeva somyedamagra āsīt, ekamevādvitīyaṃ, tatsṛṣṭ‌vā tadevānuprāviśat, " ityādivākyāni tvarthavādatayā vidhiśeṣabhūtāni, na tu svātanñyeṇārthapratipādanasamarthāni, kṛtsnasyāpi vedasya
analyzed: kiṃca kṛtsna kārya dhvaṃse sarva ātma gata adṛṣṭa dhvaṃsāt punar sṛṣṭi vaiṣamyam na syāt idam vai agre na eva kiṃcana āsīt na dyauḥ āsīt na pṛthivī na antarikṣam tathā sat eva somya idam agre āsīt ekam eva advitīyam tat sṛṣṭvā tat eva anuprāviśat ityādi vākyāni tu arthavāda tayā vidhi śeṣa bhūtāni na tu svātanñyeṇa artha pratipādana samarthāni kṛtsnasya api vedasya

original: anuṣṭheyārthatātparyāt | tacca vyutpattisiddhamiti vakṣyate | tathā sarvajñapuruṣasadbhāve ca ' kṣityādikaṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryatvāt |

original: ghaṭavat, ' ityanumānaṃ na pramāṇam, kāryatvasya śarīrikartṛkatvena vyāpteḥ, śarīriṇaśca sārvajñāsaṃbhavāt, aśarīriṇaśca kāraṇādhiṣṭhānāśakteḥ kartṛtvāsaṃbhavāt, idānīntanapuruṣaparamparāyāśca yonijatvadarśanena ayonijapuruṣasadbhāvo'pyasaṃbhāvita eveti mīmāṃsakānāmabhimānaḥ | etatsarvaṃ vimalābja nanāmni prakaraṇe'bhihitam ||
analyzed: ghaṭa vat iti anumānam na pramāṇam kāryatvasya śarīri kartṛka tvena vyāpteḥ śarīriṇaḥ ca sārvajña asaṃbhavāt aśarīriṇaḥ ca kāraṇa adhiṣṭhāna aśakteḥ kartṛ tva asaṃbhavāt idānīntana puruṣa paramparāyāḥ ca yoni ja tva darśanena ayoni ja puruṣa sadbhāvaḥ api asaṃbhāvitaḥ eva iti mīmāṃsakānām abhimānaḥ etat sarvam vimalābja na nāmni prakaraṇe abhihitam

original: nanu devadattādipadeṣu saṃketanibandhanārthapratītidarśanādgavādipadeṣvapi tathā syāt | tataścāpauruṣeyatvamabaddhamiti cet, maivam - atra saṃketasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt, anyatra vṛddhavyavahārādeva vyutpattestadabhāvāt | nanu devadattādipadeṣvapi kadācitsaṃketādarthapratītirdṛśyata iti cet, na | aniyato hi tatra saṃketaḥ, vyutpattistu niyatā |
analyzed: nanu devadatta ādi padeṣu saṃketa nibandhana artha pratīti darśanāt gavādi padeṣu api tathā syāt tatas ca apauruṣeya tvam abaddham iti ced mā evam atra saṃketasya pratyakṣa siddha tvāt anyatra vṛddha vyavahārāt eva vyutpatteḥ tad abhāvāt nanu devadatta ādi padeṣu api kadācid saṃketāt artha pratītiḥ dṛśyate iti ced na aniyataḥ hi tatra saṃketaḥ vyutpattiḥ tu niyatā

original: tasmādekatra śaktigrahanibandhanaṃ vācakatvam, anyatra tu kadācidvyavahārato vācakatvagrahe'pi saṃketanibandhanam | vācakatvapratītistu bhedāgrahāt | saṃketātpūrvaṃ gavādipadavadvācakatvāpratītiḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt ekatra śakti graha nibandhanam vācaka tvam anyatra tu kadācid vyavahārataḥ vācaka tva grahe pi saṃketa nibandhanam vācaka tva pratītiḥ tu bheda agrahāt saṃketāt pūrvam gavādi pada vat vācaka tva apratītiḥ

original: nanu saṃbandhasyāpauruṣeyatve prathamaśrutācchabdādaviśeṣeṇa sarveṣāmarthapratītissyāt, na syāt, vyutpatterapi hetutvāt | tasmādvarṇā nityāḥ,
analyzed: nanu saṃbandhasya apauruṣeya tve prathama śrutāt śabdāt aviśeṣeṇa sarveṣām artha pratītiḥ syāt na syāt vyutpatteḥ api hetu tvāt tasmāt varṇāḥ nityāḥ

original: sabandhaścāpauruṣeya iti sthitam| tad‌grahaṇaṃ ca vācakatvaśaktigrahāt | sa ca vṛddhavyavahārāditi vakṣyate ||
analyzed: sabandhaḥ ca apauruṣeyaḥ iti sthitam tad grahaṇam ca vācaka tva śakti grahāt sa ca vṛddha vyavahārāt iti vakṣyate

original: nanu kathaṃ pademyaḥ padārthapratītiḥ vākyārthapratītirvā | tatra śabdatatvavido vaiyākaraṇāḥ prāhuḥ - kramikairāśutaratirohitairvarṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ yaugapadyaina ca padārthapratītervakyārthapratīteścāsaṃbhavāttattadvarṇābhivyaṅ‌gyaṃ pratyastamitavarṇavibhāgaṃ padavākyaśabdavācyaṃ sphoṭākhyaṃ śabdatatvaṃ tanmūlameṣitavyam|
analyzed: nanu katham pademyaḥ padārtha pratītiḥ vākya artha pratītiḥ vā tatra śabda tatva vidaḥ vaiyākaraṇāḥ prāhuḥ kramikaiḥ āśutara tirohitaiḥ varṇaiḥ pratyekam ca padārtha pratīteḥ vakya artha pratīteḥ ca asaṃbhavāt tad tad varṇa abhivyaṅgyam pratyasta mita varṇa vibhāgam pada vākya śabda vācyam sphoṭa ākhyam śabda tatvam tad mūlam eṣitavyam

original: tathāhi - na caikaikavarṇagrahaṇe'rthapratītiḥ, atiprasaṅgāt | na ca yugapadgrahaṇaṃ, āśutaratirodhanāt| tato niyatakramaiḥ katipayairvarṇaiḥ padābhivyaktiḥ | tathā eva padārtha vākyārthavibhāgaścopapanna iti ||
analyzed: tathā hi na ca ekaika varṇa grahaṇa īrtha pratītiḥ atiprasaṅgāt na ca yugapad grahaṇam āśutara tirodhanāt tatas niyata kramaiḥ katipayaiḥ varṇaiḥ pada abhivyaktiḥ tathā eva padārtha vākya artha vibhāgaḥ ca upapannaḥ iti

original: apare nu pratyastamitapadavākyavibhāgamakhaṇḍaṃ śabdatatvamekameva| tatra padavākyavibhāgastu kālpanika iti pratipannaḥ ||
analyzed: apare nu pratyasta mita pada vākya vibhāgam akhaṇḍam śabda tatvam ekam eva tatra pada vākya vibhāgaḥ tu kālpanikaḥ iti pratipannaḥ

original: taccātīndriyamarthapratītyanupapattikalpyamityeke || apare tu śrotragrāhyamiti| pūrvatra vāstavapadapadārthavyutpattirvāstavavākyārthavyutpattiśca sahakāriṇī| uttaratra kālpanikī padatadarthavākyatadarthavyutpattiḥ | anyathā sarvāviśeṣeṇārthapratītiprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: tat ca atīndriyam artha pratīti anupapatti kalpyam iti eke apare tu śrotra grāhyam iti pūrvatra vāstava pada pada artha vyutpattiḥ vāstava vākya artha vyutpattiḥ ca sahakāriṇī uttaratra kālpanikī pada tad artha vākya tad artha vyutpattiḥ anyathā sarva aviśeṣeṇa artha pratīti prasaṅgāt

original: kiṃ ca " vananavanadīdīna " ityādiṣu varṇabhede'pi padānyatvaṃ pratīyate| tatastadatiriktaṃ padam | na ca vācyaṃ, varṇā eva padam, nadīdīnetyādiṣu kramabhedena padabuddhibheda iti, teṣāṃ sarvagatatvanityatvābhyāṃ deśakālakramāsaṃbhavāt | kiṃ cānekeṣu varṇeṣu ekaṃ padaṃ ekaṃ vākyamiti vyapadeśo'pi varṇānyatve pramāṇam |
analyzed: kim ca vana nava nadīdīnaḥ ityādiṣu varṇa bhede pi pada anyatvam pratīyate tatas tad atiriktam padam na ca vācyam varṇāḥ eva padam nadīdīna ityādiṣu krama bhedena pada buddhi bhedaḥ iti teṣām sarvagata tva nitya tvābhyām deśa kāla krama asaṃbhavāt kim ca anekeṣu varṇeṣu ekam padam ekam vākyam iti vyapadeśaḥ api varṇa anyatve pramāṇam

original: kiṃ ca varṇānāṃ vācakatve kramabhede vaktṛbhede vilamboccāraṇe cārthapratyayassyāditi, naitatsāram - yatnenānveṣaṇe'pi nānāvarṇavyatirekeṇa nirbhāgaśabdatatvānupalambhāt| yastvekaṃ padamekaṃ vākyamiti vyapadeśaḥ, so'pyanekeṣu aryaikyopādhinibandhanaḥ| dṛśyate hi bahūnāmapyaupādhikamekatvam | yathā ' senā vanaṃ rājasūyaḥ ' iti|
analyzed: kim ca varṇānām vācaka tve krama bhede vaktṛ bhede vilamba uccāraṇe ca artha pratyayaḥ syāt iti na etat sāram yatnena anveṣaṇe api nānā varṇa vyatirekeṇa nirbhāga śabda tatva anupalambhāt yaḥ tu ekam padam ekam vākyam iti vyapadeśaḥ saḥ api anekeṣu ari aikya upādhi nibandhanaḥ dṛśyate hi bahūnām api aupādhikam eka tvam yathā senā vanam rājasūyaḥ iti

original: ata evārthaikatvamajānatāṃ nāstyekatvaparāmarśaḥ | yadi hyanaupādhikaṃ śabdatatvaṃ syāttarhi
analyzed: atas eva artha ekatvam a jānatām na asti ekatva parāmarśaḥ yadi hi anaupādhikam śabda tatvam syāt tarhi

original: saṃhitāpāṭhamātreṇa vyutpannānāmitareṣāṃ ca prakāśeta | nanu vyutpattirapi sahakāriṇīti nātiprasaṅ‌ga iti cet, haṃta, svānubhavavisaṃvādaḥ, na hi vyutpannaḥ pumānebhirvarṇairidaṃ śadbatatvamabhivyajyata iti pratyeti |
analyzed: saṃhitā pāṭha mātreṇa vyutpannānām itareṣām ca prakāśeta nanu vyutpattiḥ api sahakāriṇī iti na atiprasaṅgaḥ iti ced haṃta sva anubhava visaṃvādaḥ na hi vyutpannaḥ pumān ebhiḥ varṇaiḥ idam śadbata tvam abhivyajyate iti pratyeti

original: kiṃ ca yāvadbhirvarṇaiśśabdatatvamabhivyaktaṃ pratiniyatārthapratyāyakaṃ tāvatāmeva vācakatvasaṃbhave'tiriktakalpanaṃ gauravaparāhatam| nadītīnetyādiṣvapi buddhibhedaḥ kramabheda nibandhanaḥ| tathāhi - uccāraṇakramānurodhātprativarṇābhivyakti bhinnā eva buddhayo jāyante|
analyzed: kim ca yāvadbhiḥ varṇaiḥ śabda tatvam abhivyaktam pratiniyata artha pratyāyakam tāvatām eva vācaka tva saṃbhava itirikta kalpanam gaurava parāhatam nadī tīna ityādiṣu api buddhi bhedaḥ krama bheda nibandhanaḥ tathā hi uccāraṇa krama anurodhāt prativarṇa abhivyakti bhinnāḥ eva buddhayaḥ jāyante

original: prativarṇaupalambhaprabhāvitabhāvanākhyasaṃskārakramavaśācca vilakṣaṇāḥ smṛtayaḥ| tatkramādvarṇā api kramavanta iva bhānti | tasmādekavakatroccāraṇāpāditanairantaryā ānu pūrvīviśeṣaśālinassvaraviśeṣabhājo varṇā eva padam | tata evārthapratyayaḥ |
analyzed: prati varṇa aupalambha prabhāvita bhāvanā ākhya saṃskāra krama vaśāt ca vilakṣaṇāḥ smṛtayaḥ tad kramāt varṇāḥ api kramavantaḥ iva bhānti tasmāt eka vakatra uccāraṇa āpādita nairantaryāḥ ānu pūrvī viśeṣa śālinaḥ svara viśeṣa bhājaḥ varṇāḥ eva padam tatas eva artha pratyayaḥ

original: na ca yugapadgrahaṇāsaṃbhavaḥ, krameṇa śrutānāmapi teṣāṃ tenaiva krameṇa paścātsmṛtiviṣayatvasaṃbhavāt | dṛśyate hi kmānubhūteṣvapi yugapadanusandhānaṃ ' pañca prayājā mayānuṣṭhitāḥ, godāvaryāṃ mahānadyāṃ śatavāraṃ snāto'ham ' iti ca ayamarthassvasiddhāntopanyāsasamaye prapañcayiṣyate |
analyzed: na ca yugapad grahaṇa asaṃbhavaḥ krameṇa śrutānām api teṣām tena eva krameṇa paścāt smṛti viṣaya tva saṃbhavāt dṛśyate hi kma anubhūteṣu api yugapad anusandhānam pañca prayājāḥ mayā anuṣṭhitāḥ godāvaryām mahā nadyām śata vāram snātaḥ aham iti ca ayam arthaḥ sva siddhānta upanyāsa samaye prapañcayiṣyate

original: atīndriyaśabdakalpanamapyanupapannam | arthapratīteranyathāsiddhatvāt | atiprasaṅgaśca tasya nityatve sarvārthapratītiprasaṅ‌gāt | anitye ca tatkāraṇaṃ durnirūpam | varṇānāṃ ca kāraṇatve tadutpattirvyarthā, uktena mārgeṇa tairevārthapratītyupapatteḥ| abhivyañjakatve tu pratyakṣatvāpātaḥ |
analyzed: atīndriya śabda kalpanam api anupapannam artha pratīteḥ anyathā siddha tvāt atiprasaṅgaḥ ca tasya nitya tve sarva artha pratīti prasaṅgāt anitye ca tad kāraṇam durnirūpam varṇānām ca kāraṇa tve tad utpattiḥ vyarthā uktena mārgeṇa taiḥ eva artha pratīti upapatteḥ abhivyañjaka tve tu pratyakṣa tva āpātaḥ

original: kiṃca vṛddhavyavahāre āvāpodvāpābhyāṃ hi śaktigrahādvyutpattiḥ | tataśca yasya padasya āvāpe yasyārthaṃbhāgasyāvāpaḥ yadudvāpe codvāpaḥ tatraiva tasya vyutpattiruktā akhaṇḍaśabdatatvāvāde kasya kutra vyutpattiḥ ? nanu tatrāpi padavibhāgaṃ parikalpya tatra tasya vyutpattiriti cet, na, pratipattigauravāt | niyatakramā varṇā eva hi padamityuktam |
analyzed: kiṃca vṛddha vyavahāre āvāpa udvāpābhyām hi śakti grahāt vyutpattiḥ tatas ca yasya padasya āvāpe yasya arthaṃbhāgasya āvāpaḥ yad udvāpe ca udvāpaḥ tatra eva tasya vyutpattiḥ uktā akhaṇḍa śabda tatva āvāde kasya kutra vyutpattiḥ nanu tatra api pada vibhāgam parikalpya tatra tasya vyutpattiḥ iti ced na pratipatti gauravāt niyata kramāḥ varṇāḥ eva hi padam iti uktam

original: kiṃ cānenaiva nyāyena vākyāryapratītyupapattau tatra vākyaṃ parikalpya tatra tasya vyutpattirvaktavyā | tatrāpi bhūyān pratipattau gauravakleśa iti
analyzed: kim ca anena eva nyāyena vākya ārya pratīti upapattau tatra vākyam parikalpya tatra tasya vyutpattiḥ vaktavyā tatra api bhūyān pratipattau gaurava kleśaḥ iti

original: pratyakṣato'numānato vā na varṇātiriktaśabdatatvasaṃbhava iti ||

original: siddhārthākhyāne tu vyutpattirduśśakaiva | yadyapi tatparavākyaprayoge mukhaprasādādibhiḥ harṣotpattiranumīyate | tayā ca taddhetupratītiḥ, tannimittatā'pi śabdasyaiva |
analyzed: siddhārtha ākhyāne tu vyutpattiḥ duśśakā eva yadi api tad para vākya prayoge mukha prasāda ādibhiḥ harṣa utpattiḥ anumīyate tayā ca tad hetu pratītiḥ tad nimitta tā api śabdasya eva

original: tathāpi pariśeṣātpramāṇāntarasiddhaputrajanmākhyaharṣahetupratipādakatā duranumānā, kālatrayavartināṃ sannihitavyavahitānāṃ pramāṇāntarasiddhānāṃ harṣahetūnāṃ pāriśepyādavadhāraṇāyogāt | tathā asya śabdasyāyamartha ityatrāpi sarvapadārthāparijñāne vyutpattirduśśakaiva | katipayapadārthajñāne tu prasiddhapadasamabhivyāhāra eva |
analyzed: tathā api pariśeṣāt pramāṇa antara siddha putra janma ākhya harṣa hetu pratipādaka tā duranumānā kāla traya vartinām sannihita vyavahitānām pramāṇa antara siddhānām harṣa hetūnām pāriśepyāt avadhāraṇā ayogāt tathā asya śabdasya ayam arthaḥ iti atra api sarva padārtha aparijñāne vyutpattiḥ duśśakā eva katipaya padārtha jñāne tu prasiddha pada samabhivyāhāraḥ eva

original: tatra prasiddhānāṃ pūrvaṃ kāryānvitasvārthe vyutpatteraprasiddhārthasyāpi padasya kāryādhyāhāreṇaiva tadanvitasvārthāvagatireṣaṇīyā | tataśca sarvapadānāṃ tatparatvaṃ siddham | evaṃ ca loke yassiddhārthaparassa lākṣāṇika eva, kāryaparaṃ padajātaṃ parasparapadārthānvayā vyabhicārīti kāryānvayamavivakṣitvā.
analyzed: tatra prasiddhānām pūrvam kārya anvita svārthe vyutpatteḥ aprasiddha arthasya api padasya kārya adhyāhāreṇa eva tad anvita svārtha avagatiḥ eṣaṇīyā tatas ca sarva padānām tad para tvam siddham evam ca loke yaḥ siddhārtha paraḥ sa lākṣāṇikaḥ eva kārya param pada jātam paraspara padārtha anvayāḥ vyabhicāri iti kārya anvayam avivakṣitvā

original: parasparapadārthanvayamātraṃ vivakṣitvā lokaśśabdaṃ prayuṅ‌kte| vivākṣāvaśena lakṣaṇayā'pi tatra tātparyaṃ nirvahatyeva | vede tu lakṣaṇānibandhanaṃ kiṃcidapi neti autsargikaṃ kāryaparatvamanavagraham |
analyzed: paraspara padārtha nvaya mātram vivakṣitvā lokaḥ śabdam prayuṅkte vivākṣā vaśena lakṣaṇayā api tatra tātparyam nirvahati eva vede tu lakṣaṇā nibandhanam kiṃcid api na iti autsargikam kārya paratvam anavagraham

original: tataśca siddhabrahmaparāṇāṃ siddhaparātmaparāṇāṃ ca ' satyaṃjñānamanantaṃ brahma, vijñānamānandaṃ brahma, tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvaṃ, yassarvajñassarvavit, dve brahmaṇī veditavyaṃ paraṃ cāparaṃ ca, dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte '| ityādividhinaikavākyatāmāśritya kāryaparatvaṃ varṇanīyam |
analyzed: tatas ca siddha brahma parāṇām siddha parātma parāṇām ca satyam jñānam anantam brahma vijñānam ānandam brahma tena idam pūrṇam puruṣeṇa sarvam yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarva vid dve brahmaṇī veditavyam param ca aparam ca dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānam vṛkṣam pariṣasvajāte ityādi vidhinā eka vākya tām āśritya kārya para tvam varṇanīyam

original: ' bhūtaṃ bhavyāya ' iti nyāyāt | sādhyaśeṣabhūtaṃ siddhamiti
analyzed: bhūtam bhavyāya iti nyāyāt sādhya śeṣa bhūtam siddham iti

original: nyāyādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nyāyāt iti arthaḥ

original: itthaṃ varṇā nityāḥ | arthāśca pravāharūpeṇa | tatsaṃbandhaścāpauruṣeyaḥ| tatparijñānaṃ ca śaktigrahāt | śaktigrahaśca vṛddhavyavahāreṇa | sa ca kāryānvitasvārthe|
analyzed: ittham varṇāḥ nityāḥ arthāḥ ca pravāha rūpeṇa tad saṃbandhaḥ ca apauruṣeyaḥ tad parijñānam ca śakti grahāt śakti grahaḥ ca vṛddha vyavahāreṇa sa ca kārya anvita svārthe

original: tatra padānyeva kāryānvitasvārthabodhakāni, na tvakhaṇḍaṃ śabdatatvaṃ, nāpyantyo varṇaḥ, nāpi padapratipāditāḥ padārthāḥ, tatra laukikaṃ padamanumānarūpaṃ, na śāstraṃ, asannikṛṣṭārthaṃvaidikameva śāstram | tadapi dvividhamityuktam | lakṣaṇavyāvartyacintātu arthagrahaṇenābhidheyavacanena | laiṅ‌gikaṃ vaktrabhiprāyajñānamaśāstramityuktam|
analyzed: tatra padāni eva kārya anvita svārtha bodhakāni na tu akhaṇḍam na api antyaḥ varṇaḥ na api pada pratipāditāḥ padārthāḥ tatra laukikam padam anumāna rūpam na śāstram asat nikṛṣṭa artham vaidikam eva śāstram tat api dvividham iti uktam lakṣaṇa vyāvartya cintā tu artha grahaṇena abhidheya vacanena laiṅgikam vaktṛ abhiprāya jñānam aśāstram iti uktam

original: asannikṛṣṭārthamiti pauruṣeyavākyābhidheyasyārthasya vaktrabhiprāyaniścayapurassaraṃ yadvijñānaṃ tanna śāstramiti | tathā'rthavādānāṃ svatantrāṇāṃ sannikṛṣṭārthaparāṇāṃ na śāstratvaṃ, kiṃ tu vidhyantarānupraveśenaiva | śabdagrahaṇena cārthasya jñānasya cāśāstratvamuktam | tathāhi -
analyzed: asannikṛṣṭa artham iti pauruṣeya vākya abhidheyasya arthasya vaktṛ abhiprāya niścaya purassaram yat vijñānam tat na śāstram iti tathā arthavādānām svatantrāṇām sannikṛṣṭa artha parāṇām na śāstra tvam kim tu vidhi antara anupraveśena eva śabda grahaṇena ca arthasya jñānasya ca aśāstra tvam uktam tathā hi

original: prakṛtau ' vāsasi minoti vāsasā somamupāvaharati ' iti somabhānamupāvaharaṇaṃ ca vihitam | tatraikatvātkarmaṇo yasminneva vāsasi somo mīyate tenaivopāvahriyata ityacoditamapi vāsasa ekatvamarthātsaṃpannam | vikṛtau tvahargaṇe pṛthaktvātsomasya ekasminnapi vāsasi nānābhūtasyāpi somasya mānaṃ śakyate kartum |
analyzed: prakṛtau vāsasi minoti vāsasā somam upāvaharati iti soma bhānam upāvaharaṇam ca vihitam tatra ekatvāt karmaṇaḥ yasmin eva vāsasi somaḥ mīyate tena eva upāvahriyate iti a coditam api vāsasaḥ ekatvam arthāt saṃpannam vikṛtau tu ahargaṇe pṛthaktvāt somasya ekasmin api vāsasi nānābhūtasya api somasya mānam śakyate kartum

original: upāvaharaṇaṃ tu puñjīkṛtya vāsasā''nayanam, tadekenāśakyamiti mānavāsaso'nyat tadarthamupādīyate | ekatvaṃ tu prakṛtāvārthaṃ, na śabdārtha iti vikṛtau codakena na prāpyata iti tatra vāsasa ekatvajñānaṃ na śāstramityuktam | ' arthaṃ na codakaḥ pratidiśati ' iti nyayāt |
analyzed: upāvaharaṇam tu puñjīkṛtya vāsasā ānayanam tat ekena aśakyam iti māna vāsasaḥ anyat tad artham upādīyate ekatvam tu prakṛtau ārtham na śabda arthaḥ iti vikṛtau ca udakena na prāpyate iti tatra vāsasaḥ ekatva jñānam na śāstram iti uktam artham na ca udakaḥ pratidiśati iti nyayāt

original: vijñānamiti nyāyābhāsāt vākyasya ca vacanavyaktimavadhārya tadarthajñānaṃ na śāstramiti | na hi tacchabdavijñānāt yādṛśaṃ hi samyaṅ‌nyāyāvadhāryavacanavyaktikaṃ tādṛśameva śāstramiti ||
analyzed: vijñānam iti nyāya ābhāsāt vākyasya ca vacana vyaktim avadhārya tad artha jñānam na śāstram iti na hi tad śabda vijñānāt yādṛśam hi samyak nyāya avadhārya vacana vyaktikam tādṛśam eva śāstram iti

original: iti śrīmadrāmānujācāryaviracite tantrarahasye śāstraparicchedastṛtīyaḥ ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat rāmānuja ācārya viracite tantrarahasye śāstra paricchedaḥ tṛtīyaḥ
